overall_goal: Season the vegetables in the pan with dry spices and sesame oil

goals.description: Season the vegetables with salt, pepper, and oregano
goals.rationale: The person grinds salt and pepper into the pan, puts the grinders away, and then sprinkles oregano over the vegetables.

goals.description: Measure and add sesame oil to the vegetables
goals.rationale: The person closes a cabinet, opens the bottle of sesame oil, and uses a spoon to measure and pour the oil into the pan before setting the spoon down.
